subtitle: Your phone is the remote now
promotionalText: One tap and your show opens on the big screen. Steer your TV and your PC from the couch. One price, no ads, no subscription, no tracking.
description:
Clankerr turns your iPhone into a fast, gorgeous remote for VIZIO SmartCast TVs and your Windows PC. Pay once, keep it forever. No ads, no subscription, no tracking.

TAP A TILE, IT OPENS ON THE TV
Your streaming apps live on big glowing tiles. Tap one and it launches on your TV in a second. Pick from more than 100 apps.

A REMOTE THAT FEELS GOOD
Swipe anywhere on the pad to move, tap to select. Back, Home and Menu are one tap away, plus play/pause, skip, a big volume rocker you can hold, mute, input and power.

EVERY TV IN THE HOUSE
Add the living room, the bedroom and the basement. Switch TVs with one tap. Moved a TV or changed your router? Clankerr finds it again on its own.

YOUR PC, FROM BED
Install the free Clankerr PC companion and your phone becomes a trackpad and keyboard for your Windows PC: move the mouse, scroll, type, control media and volume, and open apps.

KNOWS WHAT'S ON
See which app is on the TV right now, updated live.

SET UP IN SECONDS
Clankerr finds your TV on your Wi-Fi automatically. Type the 4-digit code your TV shows and you're in.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no ads, no servers. Clankerr talks only to your TV and your PC, directly over your home network.

Works with VIZIO SmartCast TVs (2016 and newer) on the same Wi-Fi as your iPhone. PC control needs Windows 10 or 11 with the free companion app.

Clankerr is an independent app and is not affiliated with or endorsed by VIZIO or Microsoft. Streaming service names are trademarks of their owners.
